Gobhaṭa
or gobhaTTa poet. Smv. p.. 53 (2 verses), 58 (2 verses), 456 (See also intro. p. 31); Skm. p.. 301 (2 verses), 305; [Page169-a. (2171. 2176 an. 2203 of Calcutta edn.). Śp. 239, 382; Subhāṣitaratnakośa 377, 1218, 1327.

Gobhila

Gobhila

May refer to Gobhilasmṛti or Karmapradīpa. NCC. Vol. III. p. 203a.
